faq.a1: HelpSmart is preparing to launch in Addis Ababa. Some features, including Fayda verification and online payments, will switch on after the required approvals.
faq.q2: Why do I need to verify my identity?
faq.a2: Verified identities help keep the community safe. You can browse without verifying, but booking, messaging and reviews need a verified account.
faq.a3: During launch you agree a price in the app and pay the professional in cash or by bank transfer. Online payments with licensed partners are coming.
faq.a4: No. In an emergency, call the police on 991 or an ambulance on 907.

verify.title: Verify your identity.
verify.body: Help us build a safe and trusted community by verifying your identity through Ethiopia's National Digital ID system.
verify.consent: I consent to HelpSmart receiving my identity verification result from Fayda, and the minimum details needed to confirm who I am. HelpSmart never sees or stores my Fayda OTP or biometrics, and never shows my FIN or FAN publicly.
verify.step1: You'll be taken to the official Fayda sign-in page.
verify.step2: You confirm your identity and consent directly with Fayda.
verify.step3: Fayda sends the result securely to HelpSmart and you return here.
verify.unavailableBody: HelpSmart is completing its official Fayda partner authorisation. You can browse services now. Booking, messaging and reviews unlock once verification opens.
verify.devFixture: Development environment: identity results here are simulated fixtures, never real verifications.
